_note: REACHED VIA PROBE: SeoScreen reads and writes through
`composer.getProjectSettings()/setProjectSettings()`, so a four-method stub
is the whole dependency. Hosted in the board's own pane —
`.bd-set-pane-body` at 824, which is 760 (the card) plus its two 32 insets.
Same host and arithmetic as s7-settings-general.
ALREADY CONFORMANT where the two agree: 20 properties on the SITE SEO card,
its title and the two fields both sides have. The chassis arrived with
s7-settings-general's family-wide move to settings/shared.tsx.
NOT CONFORMED — 638:3384 'Meta title' and 638:3388 'Meta description', and
THE BOARD'S OWN ANNOTATION IS WHY. 2876:12473 sits at the top of this frame
and reads: 'This screen sets the site-level title template, Twitter handle
and default OG image (SeoScreen.tsx:76-141); each page's own meta title,
description and social image live in Pages > page settings > SEO...
[design-ahead] The resolution is drawn nowhere.' So the frame draws two rows
the same frame's note says belong to a different screen — the card is an
earlier draft and the annotation supersedes it. Live's first row is 'Title
template', which is what the note describes and what the product does; it is
measured here (field-title-template) but not joined to a board node, because
no board node names it. The annotation itself is not conformed either: it is
a founder's sticky note about an unresolved UX problem, not a card.
NOT CONFORMED — 638:3400, the whole INDEXING card ('Allow search indexing'
toggle + a robots.txt code block). Nothing in the product corresponds: there
is no indexing flag in project settings and no robots.txt generator to read
one. That is a feature, not drift, and the board is the first place it has
been drawn. REPORTED for the orchestrator — it is the largest single gap on
this board.
ALSO NOT JOINED — the Inputs (638:3386 / 3390 / 3394 / 3398): 42 high, 320
wide, radius 8 on a --color/ink near-black border. Same node and the same
adjudication s7-settings-general already recorded for the shared
SETTINGS_TEXT_INPUT_THEME; an ink-black border on every settings input is a
reading no other board supports. Left for the founder.
FOUND, NOT FIXED: live ends with a note — 'Per-page SEO (meta title,
description, robots) is set in each page's settings via the Pages tab' —
which is the product's own answer to the problem 2876:12473 describes, and
it is doing more work than the board credits. It is also the one place the
two screens are linked, and it is prose, not a link: it names the Pages tab
but does not go there. The board's note asks for exactly that ('this screen
does not say how many pages override the default'), and neither side has it.
